verdict: Meta is carrying results; Google spend needs an immediate fix.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 31 leads at an average cost of $135.76 per lead — all 31 came from Meta, which spent $1,461.60. Google Ads spent $2,747.11 over the same window and produced only 2 conversions, putting its effective cost per lead at roughly $1,373; that imbalance is the dominant issue this period. Lead volume also fell 37.5% in the most recent 7 days compared to the prior 7, and cost per lead rose 60% week-over-week, driven almost entirely by Google's underperformance. Google campaign spend is being reviewed and reallocated so that budget works harder where results are actually coming in. The expectation for next period is a lower blended cost per lead as Google dollars are either corrected or shifted toward what is converting.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, every one sourced from Meta
spent on Google Ads this period for only 2 conversions
drop in leads this week compared to the prior week

watch_item.issue: 111 leads have entered your CRM this period with 0 appointments booked and 0 cases won — leads are arriving but not being followed up on, which is a intake process gap, not an ads gap.
watch_item.fix: We are flagging this for immediate review so that incoming leads are contacted and tracked through to a consultation.
